description: Elections Commission - The Main Electoral Register for the Year 2024 Related to the Revision of the Electoral Registers for the Year 2024 was Certified on 01 July 2024.
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral processes, including the certification of the main electoral register for 2024 and the allocation of parliamentary seats to electoral districts. It is issued by the Election Commission under constitutional authority (Article 98(8)) and electoral legislation (Registration of Electors Act). The content focuses entirely on election administration matters - specifically the determination of representation numbers for electoral districts - which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7).
